galery.title: My projects
galery.subtitle: Real websites built to improve online presence

projects.title: HomeSilva — Real estate website
projects.desc:
A real estate agency with over 15 years of experience that needed a modern online presence to showcase its properties and generate new inquiries.

I designed and developed a digital property catalog with individual listing pages, search filters, interactive maps, and direct contact options, making it easier for visitors to find properties of interest and reach out to the agency quickly.
The platform remains active and growing, with continuous improvements and new features.

projects.title: Babaria — Cosmetics brand website
projects.desc:
A cosmetics brand with over 40 years of history that needed to strengthen its digital presence and better communicate its brand identity.

I developed an 'About Us' section focused on telling the company's story, highlighting its key ingredients, and conveying its values through visual content and video.
The goal was to help visitors understand who's behind the brand before making a purchase decision, building trust and connection with its products.

projects.title: Plus Solution Flooring Corp — Flooring company website
projects.desc:
A flooring installation and sales company in Florida that needed an online platform to showcase its services, sell products, and generate new inquiries from the internet.

I developed a website with a product catalog, shopping cart, service pages, contact form, and a structure optimized for conversion.

The goal was to unify product sales and client acquisition for installation services on a single platform, making it easy for users to get quotes, buy, or request information quickly and directly.

The site is designed to improve the user experience and increase contact opportunities from organic traffic and ad campaigns.

projects.title: DailyNotes — Productivity mobile app
projects.desc: A simple, customizable, and efficient notes app to boost your productivity. Lets you organize your day, set goals, and keep up with your routines without wasting time. Available on Google Play, with folders, weekly tracking, and daily management.

projects.title: Nurani Timepieces — Watch brand website
projects.desc:
A premium watch brand specializing in imported products that needed its own online presence to showcase its collections and attract potential customers.

I designed and developed a web catalog with men's and women's collections, plus a contact form with a discount incentive to capture leads.
The goal was to give the brand a professional platform to present its products, strengthen its digital presence, and turn visitors into potential customers.

projects.title: Interior design studio website
projects.desc:
An interior design studio that needed a website capable of faithfully reflecting its visual identity and presenting its portfolio professionally.

I developed a custom landing page with a project gallery, original illustrations, and contact options, turning the client's design into a fully mobile-responsive web experience.
The project focused on respecting every visual detail on both desktop and mobile, ensuring a brand-consistent experience and a polished presentation of the studio's work.

projects.title: Foodie Fusion — Restaurant website
projects.desc:
A restaurant that needed a professional online presence where customers could check the menu, learn about the business, and easily access important information from any device.

I designed and developed a website with an online menu, dish gallery, location, and custom features for users, creating a more accessible and appealing experience for visitors.
The goal was to help the restaurant present its services professionally, improve customer interaction, and keep all relevant information available online.

projects.title: Urban clothing store — Online store template
projects.desc: An online store with a shopping cart, product categories, and a profile with order history. Personal project. Works like a real store: you can add products, watch the total update, and review your past purchases in your profile.

about.title: About me
about.subtitle: I'm a freelance web developer with over 5 years of experience helping small businesses, brands, and companies across different industries get more clients. I've worked independently with clients of all sizes, both in Argentina and in other countries across Latin America and the United States, which taught me to understand what each business needs before writing a single line of code.
about.subtitleRest: I'm self-taught — I'm constantly learning to use current tools, which results in websites that are faster, more modern, and easier to maintain. I don't work at an agency or with a large team. When you hire me, you talk directly with me.

faq.subtitle: These are the questions clients ask me most before starting a project.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions about

faqs.preg: How long does it take to build the website?
faqs.res: It depends on the project. A landing page can be ready in 1 to 2 weeks. An e-commerce site or more complex project can take 3 to 5 weeks. I always give you a clear timeline before starting.

faqs.preg: How much does a website cost?
faqs.res: Every project is different, so I don't have fixed prices. But I can give you a free quote after a quick chat. Message me and we'll go over it.

faqs.preg: Do I need to know about technology to work with you?
faqs.res: Not at all. I explain things in simple terms and guide you through every step. You focus on your business, I take care of the rest.

faqs.preg: Can I update the website myself afterward?
faqs.res: Yes. Depending on the type of project, I'll deliver the site with a simple panel so you can make basic changes without relying on anyone.

faqs.preg: What happens if I need changes after it's published?
faqs.res: Minor adjustments during the delivery period are free. For changes afterward, we can set up a monthly maintenance plan or handle it on a case-by-case basis.

faqs.preg: Do you work with clients from any industry?
faqs.res: Yes. I've worked with restaurants, stores, cosmetics brands, real estate agencies, and more. If you have a business and need an online presence, I can help.

why.title: More than just a website
why.subtitle: Every project is designed to help your business build trust, attract more clients, and have a professional online presence.

razones.title: Built to generate inquiries, not just to exist
razones.des: Every section — from the copy to the contact buttons — is designed to get visitors to take the next step: message you, request a quote, or buy. It's not a digital business card, it's a sales tool.

razones.title: Every website is built around your business, not a template
razones.des: Before designing anything, we talk about how your business works, who your customers are, and what you want to achieve. The site is built from that, not the other way around.

razones.title: Make a great first impression
razones.des: A polished design and a clear structure help any visitor understand in seconds who you are, what you offer, and why they should choose you over the competition.

razones.title: You focus on your business, I focus on the technology
razones.des: I handle the design, development, and launch without you needing to understand any code. If you need to make simple changes afterward, I'll leave you an easy-to-use panel; for everything else, I'm just a message away.

razones.title: You always talk to me, not a support ticket
razones.des: No middlemen, no support teams. If a question comes up along the way or something isn't working as expected, you message me directly and we solve it together.

why.cierre: A website shouldn't just be an online presence. It should become a tool to grow your business.

casos.title: How I help businesses grow their digital presence
casos.subtitle: Every project starts with a real goal: improving how a company presents itself, attracts clients, and scales its business online.

casos.title: HomeSilva
casos.objetivo: Digitize the property portfolio and generate more inquiries from potential clients.
casos.solucion: I designed and developed a real estate platform with individual property listings, search filters, interactive maps, optimized landing pages, and direct contact forms. I also built an admin panel so the agency can upload and manage its properties independently.
casos.resultado: The agency now has its own platform to manage and showcase its property portfolio, improve the search experience, and increase inquiries without relying on third parties.

casos.title: PS Flooring
casos.objetivo: Strengthen the business's digital presence, showcase installation services, prepare for material sales, and expand into new services like epoxy.
casos.solucion: I developed a bilingual (English/Spanish) platform with a service and product catalog, login system, shopping cart, checkout, contact forms, custom quotes, and an estimate calculator for clients. I also included sections for completed projects and featured work to build trust.
casos.resultado: The company now has a platform ready to attract new clients, sell materials online, and evolve its business model from services toward a hybrid offering of installation and product sales.

footer.title: I help businesses and small companies improve their digital presence with fast, conversion-focused websites.
